authorization: User explicitly requested immediate execution of the next upstream layer-by-component mediation experiment

panel.claim_boundary: candidate localization is development evidence until any selected compact mediator is independently confirmed

source_interface.alignment: ordered donor source positions mapped to ordered target slots with endpoints fixed
source_interface.patch_semantics: replace the complete hidden state at the candidate residual or normalized additive-branch hook only at informative-prefix source positions; retain all other target-natural states
source_interface.pre_rope_kv_endpoint: for every selected K12 query head, concatenate the corresponding pre-RoPE key and value projections at aligned informative-prefix positions
source_interface.downstream_endpoint: the exact full-prefix KV intervention from Day 60, recomputed on the same example and target context

candidate_classes.compact_branches: whole normalized attention and MLP additive branches at layers 0 through 11

controls.identity: same-condition replacement at every candidate in preflight
controls.matched_orthogonal: for every candidate and direction, apply one deterministic shared signed coordinate permutation to the exact aligned hidden delta, preserving every row norm and temporal Gram matrix
controls.seed_rule: orthogonal_base_seed plus candidate index in candidate_order

classification.compact_single_branch: one or more attention/MLP branch candidates pass every gate in both directions; report every qualifier and select the first in chronological attention-before-MLP order
classification.residual_state_only: no branch qualifies, but one or more residual boundaries qualify; report the earliest qualifying residual boundary as the first sufficient state, not as a compact writer
classification.distributed_no_single_site: no candidate passes every gate in both directions
classification.causal_horizon: a site at or after a selected K12 layer must still pass the frozen per-K12-layer gates and receives no exemption for structural lateness

stop_rules: do not add or remove candidates, regions, endpoints, controls, gates, or directions after cross-condition outcomes
do not call a residual-boundary result a compact component mediator
do not infer parameter origin from activation-state mediation
do not independently confirm a selected candidate without a separately frozen fresh panel
terminate only the exact dedicated Day 61 worker after artifact recovery
